approval.prompt: Original image-to-3D concept for faceted waterfront FPS. Single coherent isolated game prop centered on plain light grey background, full object visible in three-quarter front view. Clean broad triangulated flat-shaded geometry, one solid colour per material, no grain, dirt, outlines, drawn seams, logos, text, people, floor or surrounding scenery. Believable construction, strong readable silhouette. A compact shop clothes display rail on two charcoal steel feet, with six broad faceted hanging coats in warm ivory, slate blue and muted olive, spaced in irregular groups. No mannequin, no text.
